request.prompt:

drift instead of two times.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored

agent.result_text:
Momentum is now thrust + 3 × drift, and `bin/e2e` passes. The test checks Dana at 33 and Ravi at 8, and that drift is still 7 and −2.

The change was one line, because momentum is only calculated on the server: `getMomentum()` in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/people/Person.java:80` now uses `3 * drift`. The front end just shows the value it gets from the server. I also updated the comments in `Person.java` and `people.ts` that still described the old formula. Stored data and test seeding didn't need to change, since momentum is never stored.
